answer: Locks are entered in juniper, expire in cipher, and lagoon lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 137 aliases as a result needs 182 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 23 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
